profile.subtitle: Manage your personal information, avatar, and security settings.

admin_users.subtitle: Create, edit, lock, unlock, and manage organization user accounts.

admin_users.delete_desc: They lose access immediately. Their past activity stays in the audit log.
admin_users.modal_create_desc: They'll get a one-time link to set a password. There is no public sign-up.

admin_statuses.title: Task statuses
admin_statuses.subtitle: Configure system-wide workflow statuses. Each status belongs to one of four categories.
admin_statuses.info_body: Projects use these names. Color, board columns, and reports follow the category: To do, In progress, Review, Done.
admin_statuses.delete_desc: Projects stop offering this status. This can't be undone.

admin_audit.title: Audit log
admin_audit.subtitle: Trace who changed what and when across users, projects, tasks, sprints, and statuses.
admin_audit.empty_audit: No audit log entries match the selected filters.
